values.scale: 100,000 = most valuable player on each sheet; values add
values.model: Trade values: credibility-weighted PPG over replacement x expected games; dynasty through 2031 with aging, survival, stop-loss upside and 15%/yr discount; status-based expected games (injury report, depth chart). Weekly R build with 6 output gates.
values.projected: Projections for the rest of 2026 and 2027-2031; 2026 games played so far are actual.

prospects.projected: 2027 prospects are projections from 2026 college stats (pro-rated to 12 games); the mock pick stands in for draft capital.

checks: every row of every grade and value file has exactly one player id
no two players share an id
at most 10% of valued players lack an NFL id
at most 2% of ids disappear and the player count moves at most 10% from the last build
limits: No combine data and no draft capital in the pre-draft model, on purpose.
Grades rank within position; Value is the cross-position measure.
Players are joined across files by official NFL id where one exists, else by name, position and class.
